verdicts.reason: A wraps the headline 'Chase the Light' into three oversized lines that collide with the right circle. It squeezes the tagline into a five-line ragged column jammed between the product and the CTA. It also pushes the SOLSTICE logo down to the bottom-left, under the circle, where it reads as an afterthought, and the 'New Flavor' badge is tiny and illegible inside the circle. B keeps the headline, tagline and CTA together in one right-hand block that reads in order, but it still has flaws: the badge is so small you can't read it and it floats in the circle, the logo is tiny and squeezed against the circle edge, the tagline nearly touches the CTA, and the middle and left have dead space.
